title: CHINESEWEBTEXT 2.0: LARGE-SCALE HIGH-QUALITY CHINESE WEB TEXT WITH MULTI-DIMENSIONAL AND FINE-GRAINED INFORMATION

bias_targets.methodology: Rule-based filtering using a handcrafted sensitive word list to identify and remove texts containing explicit references to racial discrimination during the dataset preprocessing stage.
Evaluating text toxicity by training a FastText classification model incorporating the SWSR dataset, which specifically targets online sexism detection.
Evaluating text toxicity by training a FastText classification model incorporating the CDial-Bias dataset, which identifies and targets social bias in dialogue systems.

Using an LLM-in-the-loop and FastText-based classification system trained on various offensive language and toxicity benchmarks (e.g., COLD, ToxiCN) to assign a fine-grained toxicity score to each text.
